name: PII Blackout
tagline: Offline PII Removal for PDF, Word & Excel. 100% Offline.
description: PII Blackout is offline document redaction software for solo attorneys, paralegals, and small businesses. It auto-detects 70+ PII types (SSNs, names, bank accounts, credit cards, custom keywords) across PDF, Word (.docx), and Excel (.xlsx), lets you review highlights, then applies permanent pixel-level blackout — all on your desktop with zero cloud uploads.
